root_cause.exact_exception: ValueError: paired day bootstrap requires at least two KST days
root_cause.mechanism: Under pinned pandas 3.0.1, the exact OOF time column is datetime64[us, UTC]. astype('int64') therefore emits microseconds. align_exact_incumbent names those integers _time_ns and later passes them to pd.to_datetime without an explicit unit, which interprets them as nanoseconds. The correct 61-day 2024 September-October interval is compressed by 1000 into one Asia/Seoul calendar day near 1970.
